title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program 2026-27 Late Payment Fee Schedule: Repeat Late Month Addition
content:
The board-approved 2026-27 late payment fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program adds a fixed amount to a month's late payment fee. The amount depends on the late payment fees already posted on the enrollment for earlier billing months.

| Late payment fees already posted on the enrollment for earlier billing months | Addition |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10.00 |
| exactly one | 5.00 |
| none | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- The count is of late payment fee entries on the enrollment's billing history for earlier billing months. A late payment fee credited back as a courtesy waiver remains a fee that was posted.
- Only the same enrollment counts. Late payment fees on a sibling's enrollment are not counted.

## Examples (hypothetical enrollment)

| Late months before the month priced | Addition |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| one, in an earlier month | 5.00 |
| two | 10.00 |
| four | 10.00 |
